notes.title: Ver1.01 Tutorial mode and bug fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37518560/a9687cfff57d2c3907fbff411fee1a9e3626b0e6.png[/img]
　This is the update information for the game.

・Tutorial mode
　⇒　Implemented to make the game rules easier for new players to understand

・Bug Fixes
　⇒　Fixed some parts of the audio that were not affected by the volume control
　⇒　The settings around the language have been made easier to understand.
　⇒　Other minor problems

　I hope you'll continue to keep up with me in the future, although this will be a leisurely update.

notes.title: "NoWaitHero" is now on sale.
notes.content:
"NoWaitHero" is a card battle where you can always enjoy your turn with no waiting time.
In this game, as the player uses his cards, the enemy also moves.
It's your turn all the time, so you can do what you want right away.

　However, it's not easy to win.
The enemy's actions are predictable, but the number of cards you can use and the number of cards you can choose is limited, so it's a tough fight to the death.

　I hope you enjoy playing and enjoy it.
